issues.display_title: Issue #240: feat(stitching): Add External Multiblend blending engine to Stitcher Alin (pano.exe)
issues.main_description_html:
Summary & Objective

Implement external Multiblend blending support for the Stitcher Alin (pano.exe) stitching pipeline, enabling high-performance multi-band blending via arms-length child process invocation without licensing contamination (ADR-Multiblend Exclusion Amendment 1).

Scope of Work

  1. Engine Rebuild (pano.exe):

    • Rebuilt protected pano.exe from GoThruMedia/pano-stitcher-a@main with HS1 challenge-response protection enabled (--protection secret).
    • Supports CLI flags --blend external, --external-executable <path>, and --keep-external-layers.
    • Bypasses quarter-power internal blend space and exports standard sRGB TIFF layers with associated alpha masks to temp directory.

  2. Backend Rust Integration (gothru-photo-studio-tauri):

    • Extended StitchConfig and parse_config in src-tauri/src/commands/stitching.rs to whitelist 'external' for alin_blend and parse alin_external_executable.
    • Updated stitching_alin.rs to construct --blend external --external-executable <path> render argv.
    • Implemented zero-configuration resolution defaulting to bundled fisheye-stitch/models/multiblend.exe when no manual path is supplied.
    • Fail-fast hard error when no binary is found (no silent degradation to internal multiband).

  3. Frontend & Settings UI:

    • Added External Multiblend option to AlinBlendMethod dropdown in Settings.tsx.
    • Added custom executable path input in Settings with helper text.
    • Updated Redux slice (stitchingSlice.ts), payload assembly (useStitching.ts), IPC type definitions, and localized strings across 18 languages in src/locales/*.json.

  4. Testing & Quality Gate:

    • Rust integration tests: cargo test --test test_stitching_alin_external_blend (7/7 passed).
    • Security handshake test: cargo test --test test_pano_handshake (7/7 passed, including bundled pano.exe).
    • Frontend tests: Redux slice & payload builder unit tests (11/11 passed).
    • Strict typecheck: tsc --noEmit (clean).

Verification & Handshake Status

  • Standalone fail-closed execution verified (exit code 42 without handshake responder).
  • Handshake with Rust responder verified (exit 0).
  • External blend TIFF layer export & multiblend execution verified against real datasets.
